items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: Parker Berry knew Nat Cole from the time that I think he was with Les Hines

ctx.x: Nat King Cole; I didn't know that. No, I didn't do any; I toured with him. I remember one particular that I'll never forget but show you really a lot of way that reputation that the Jews have; they kind of know what they're doing though. Parker Berry knew Nat Cole from the time that I think he was with Les Hines, when Nat first went to Los Angeles with that very good band, that broke up. He decided then, that the band broke up, so they decided to have a little trio. Well, they came through all right with the trio…

say that? He said, I used to say that. He said I had a big band once and he said, I said I couldn't sing. The band broke up, I went and got a job with a trio and just playing an instrument but when the guy came up and said we had to sing I went jiving around because the man said if I played there I had to sing some. So that's the way this trio started and I always said I couldn't sing. And believe it or not, they are fixing now, to put me out as a singer.
